paragraphs.source_en: I resisted the urge to throw a fit. I glanced at Commodore Kenny, who was standing to the side of the control room. paragraphs.source_en: The department heads jumped into a quick discussion. I resisted the urge to say anything, and stayed quiet. Seconds were ticking by and the uncertainties of the enemy’s position were growing. Someone pointed out that if we sank the other ship we would have to report that by communicating, and when we did, we’d get the broadcast then. And oh, by the way, there’d be no one around to counterdetect us at that point!
